## Audit Methodology

This report should be based on actual observations, appropriate SEO tools, and reliable documentation.

Do not report unverified metrics, ranking guarantees, or unsupported performance claims.

## Disclaimer

This audit provides recommendations, not guaranteed ranking or business outcomes. Search visibility depends on multiple factors, and results may vary.
